The '''Gryffus''' was an [[Alderaan/Legends|Alderaanian]] [[Bird/Legends|bird of prey]]. The [[Alderaanian/Legends|Alderaanian]] [[Conn Doruggan]] earned the nickname from his friends [[Pul]] and [[Tannan]] for his [[Wegsphere]] skill.
